meaning.en: to feel low and in poor spirits (temporarily)

literal.en: to feel low (the SAD IS DOWN metaphor)

usage.en: feel/be down (about sth) → the person's state. bring sb down / get sb down → cause (subject = the thing that lowers your mood).
usage.tr: feel/be down (about sth) → kişinin hâli. bring sb down / get sb down → sebep (özne = moral bozan şey).

collocations.en: a bit / kind of / really down · down lately
collocations.tr: a bit / kind of / really down · down lately

sentences.en: I've been [feeling kind of down] lately — I don't really know why.
sentences.tr: Son zamanlarda biraz moralsizim, nedenini de pek bilmiyorum.
sentences.de: Ich bin in letzter Zeit irgendwie niedergeschlagen – ich weiß nicht genau, warum.

sentences.en: She's a bit [down] about not getting the job.
sentences.tr: İşi alamadığı için biraz morali bozuk.
sentences.de: Sie ist ein bisschen geknickt, weil sie den Job nicht bekommen hat.

meaning.en: a mix of sad + hurt + a little angry
meaning.tr: üzgün + kırgın + biraz da kızgın karışımı bir hâl
meaning.de: eine Mischung aus traurig, verletzt und ein wenig verärgert

equivalent.de: aufgewühlt sein, gekränkt sein, traurig sein

usage.en: be/get upset (about/over sth) · upset with sb (hurt by / cross with someone) · upset sb (transitive) · upsetting (distressing)
usage.tr: be/get upset (about/over sth) · upset with sb (birine kırgın/kızgın) · upset sb (geçişli) · upsetting (üzücü)

collocations.en: really upset · visibly upset · Don't get upset.
collocations.tr: really upset · visibly upset · Don't get upset.

sentences.en: She's really [upset] about what you said.
sentences.de: Sie ist wirklich gekränkt wegen dem, was du gesagt hast.

sentences.en: Are you [upset with] me?
sentences.de: Bist du böse auf mich?

sentences.en: I didn't mean to [upset] you.
sentences.de: Ich wollte dich nicht kränken.

meaning.en: to be disappointed and a bit low
meaning.tr: hayal kırıklığına uğramış, canı sıkılmış olmak
meaning.de: enttäuscht und ein bisschen geknickt sein

usage.en: be bummed (out) (about sth / that …) · bum sb out · "That's a bummer." (noun: an annoying, disappointing situation)
usage.tr: be bummed (out) (about sth / that …) · bum sb out · "That's a bummer." (isim: can sıkıcı durum)

sentences.en: I'm so [bummed] that the trip got cancelled.
sentences.de: Ich bin so enttäuscht, dass die Reise abgesagt wurde.

sentences.en: He's pretty [bummed out] about missing the game.
sentences.tr: Maçı kaçırdığı için bayağı canı sıkkın.
sentences.de: Er ist ziemlich geknickt, weil er das Spiel verpasst hat.

equivalent.de: am Boden zerstört sein, total enttäuscht sein

literal.en: with the insides removed (like a fish)

usage.en: be gutted (about sth / that …). Intensifier: absolutely gutted.
usage.tr: be gutted (about sth / that …). Güçlendirme: absolutely gutted.

sentences.en: I was absolutely [gutted] when we lost in the final.
sentences.de: Ich war am Boden zerstört, als wir das Finale verloren haben.

sentences.en: She's [gutted] she can't come.
sentences.de: Sie ist todtraurig, dass sie nicht kommen kann.

meaning.en: to suffer deep pain (especially over love or loss)
meaning.tr: (özellikle aşk ya da kayıp yüzünden) derin acı çekmek
meaning.de: tiefen Schmerz empfinden (vor allem wegen Liebe oder Verlust)

equivalent.de: untröstlich sein; jemandem das Herz brechen

literal.en: to have a broken heart / to break someone's heart

usage.en: be heartbroken (over/about) → state. break sb's heart → cause. "It breaks my heart to + verb". For a minor hurt (Turkish "kalbimi kırdın") say: You hurt my feelings.
usage.tr: be heartbroken (over/about) → durum. break sb's heart → sebep. "It breaks my heart to + fiil". Türkçedeki hafif "kalbimi kırdın" için: You hurt my feelings.

sentences.en: She was [heartbroken] when they split up.
sentences.de: Sie war untröstlich, als sie sich getrennt haben.

sentences.en: It [breaks my heart] to see him like this.
sentences.de: Es bricht mir das Herz, ihn so zu sehen.

meaning.en: to be completely crushed by news or a loss
meaning.de: von einer Nachricht oder einem Verlust völlig erschüttert sein

equivalent.de: am Boden zerstört sein, erschüttert sein

usage.en: be devastated (by sth / to hear / that …). ✗ very devastated → absolutely devastated.
usage.tr: be devastated (by sth / to hear / that …). ✗ very devastated → absolutely devastated.

sentences.en: He was [devastated] when his dad passed away.
sentences.de: Er war am Boden zerstört, als sein Vater starb.

sentences.en: We were [devastated] by the news.
sentences.de: Die Nachricht hat uns tief erschüttert.

meaning.en: to fail someone who was relying on you
meaning.de: jemanden enttäuschen, der sich auf einen verlassen hat

usage.en: let sb down (transitive, separable) → the one who does it. feel let down (by sb) → the one it happens to. a letdown (noun) → something that falls short of expectations.
usage.tr: let sb down (geçişli, ayrılabilir) → yapan. feel let down (by sb) → uğrayan. a letdown (isim) → beklentiyi karşılamayan şey.

collocations.en: let the team down · Don't let me down. · a bit of a letdown
collocations.tr: let the team down · Don't let me down. · a bit of a letdown

sentences.en: I trusted you and you [let me down].
sentences.tr: Sana güvendim, sen de beni yüzüstü bıraktın.
sentences.de: Ich habe dir vertraut, und du hast mich im Stich gelassen.

sentences.en: I feel so [let down] by the whole team.
sentences.tr: Bütün ekip beni hayal kırıklığına uğrattı.
sentences.de: Ich fühle mich vom ganzen Team so im Stich gelassen.

sentences.en: The movie was a bit of a [letdown].
sentences.de: Der Film war eine kleine Enttäuschung.

meaning.en: (of a situation) to gradually make someone unhappy
meaning.de: (von einer Situation) jemanden nach und nach unglücklich machen

usage.en: sth gets sb down (subject = the cause). "Don't let it get you down." is a very common pattern.
usage.tr: sth gets sb down (özne = sebep). "Don't let it get you down." kalıbı çok yaygın.

sentences.en: This weather is really [getting me down].
sentences.de: Dieses Wetter zieht mich echt runter.

sentences.en: Don't let one bad review [get you down].
sentences.tr: Tek bir kötü yorum moralini bozmasın.
sentences.de: Lass dich von einer schlechten Kritik nicht runterziehen.

usage.en: get your hopes up (about sth) · get sb's hopes up. Mostly negative: "Don't get your hopes up."
usage.tr: get your hopes up (about sth) · get sb's hopes up. Çoğunlukla olumsuz: "Don't get your hopes up."

sentences.en: I don't want to [get my hopes up], but the interview went really well.
sentences.tr: Fazla umutlanmak istemiyorum ama mülakat çok iyi geçti.
sentences.de: Ich will mir keine zu großen Hoffnungen machen, aber das Gespräch lief richtig gut.

sentences.en: Don't [get your hopes up] — he cancels all the time.
sentences.de: Mach dir keine Hoffnungen – er sagt ständig ab.

meaning.en: to get tears in your eyes (without actually crying yet)
meaning.de: Tränen in die Augen bekommen (ohne schon richtig zu weinen)

equivalent.de: feuchte Augen bekommen, jemandem kommen die Tränen

variety.en: AmE + BrE ("well up" is also common in BrE)

usage.en: Intransitive: tear up, teared up. Careful: tear up /ter ʌp/, tore up = to rip to pieces (a completely different verb).
usage.tr: Geçişsiz: tear up, teared up. Dikkat: tear up /ter ʌp/, tore up = yırtıp atmak (bambaşka fiil).

sentences.en: I [teared up] during the last scene.
sentences.de: Bei der letzten Szene kamen mir die Tränen.

sentences.en: She started [tearing up] when she talked about her grandma.
sentences.de: Sie bekam feuchte Augen, als sie von ihrer Oma erzählte.

meaning.en: to lose control and start crying; to collapse emotionally
meaning.tr: kendini tutamayıp ağlamaya başlamak, duygusal olarak çökmek
meaning.de: die Beherrschung verlieren und anfangen zu weinen; seelisch zusammenbrechen

literal.en: to stop working, to fall apart (like a car)

usage.en: Intransitive: break down (in tears / crying). break sb down = to wear down someone's resistance (different). Noun: a breakdown.
usage.tr: Geçişsiz: break down (in tears / crying). break sb down = birinin direncini kırmak (farklı). İsim: a breakdown.

collocations.en: break down in tears · completely break down
collocations.tr: break down in tears · completely break down

sentences.en: She [broke down] in tears in the middle of the meeting.
sentences.de: Sie ist mitten im Meeting in Tränen ausgebrochen.

sentences.en: I held it together all day and then [broke down] as soon as I got home.
sentences.tr: Bütün gün kendimi tuttum, eve girer girmez dağıldım.
sentences.de: Ich habe mich den ganzen Tag zusammengerissen und bin dann zu Hause sofort zusammengebrochen.

expressions.expr: go through a lot / a rough patch

meaning.en: to be having a difficult time

equivalent.tr: zor günler geçirmek, çok şey yaşamak
equivalent.de: viel durchmachen, eine schwere Phase haben

literal.en: to pass through a lot / through a rough stretch of ground
literal.tr: çok şeyin içinden geçmek / engebeli bir bölgeden geçmek

usage.en: be going through a lot / a hard time / a rough patch (also of couples). Short form: "I'm going through it right now."
usage.tr: be going through a lot / a hard time / a rough patch (çiftler için de). Kısa hâli: "I'm going through it right now."

sentences.en: Go easy on her — she's [going through a lot] right now.
sentences.tr: Ona biraz anlayış göster, şu sıralar zor bir dönemden geçiyor.
sentences.de: Sei nachsichtig mit ihr – sie macht gerade viel durch.

sentences.en: We [went through a rough patch] last year, but we're good now.
sentences.tr: Geçen yıl ilişkimiz zor bir dönemden geçti ama şimdi iyiyiz.
sentences.de: Letztes Jahr hatten wir eine schwierige Phase, aber jetzt ist alles gut.
